title: Ratio Imaging Analyzer (RIA): A Standalone, Zero-Dependency Tool for Robust Ratiometric Fluorescence Analysis (v1.1.1)
description:
Ratio Imaging Analyzer (RIA) v1.1.1 is an open-source desktop application designed to streamline the processing of ratiometric fluorescence imaging data (e.g., FRET, Calcium, pH sensors).

v1.1.1 Update Highlights:
To balance portability with professional power, RIA is now available in two editions:

  • ⚡ RIA Lite (Standalone EXE): A re-engineered, ultra-compact executable optimized for instant startup and maximum portability on standard Windows PCs.
  • 💎 RIA Pro (Python/PyPI): The full-featured Python version that integrates comprehensive dependencies including Olympus .oir, Nikon .nd2, and Zeiss .czi.

Key Features:

  • 🧠 Robust Motion Correction: Integrates the Enhanced Correlation Coefficient (ECC) algorithm.
  • 📉 Scientific-Grade Signal Processing: Implements custom Normalized Convolution to handle NaN values correctly.
  • ✨ High-Contrast ROI System: Features a custom multi-layered rendering engine.
  • 📊 Analysis Unchained: Allows rigorous background subtraction and time-series extraction on personal laptops.
